credits.title: Dead Net
credits.overview: A promising young tennis player finds her dreams threatened when she is targeted by a mysterious figure who is out for her blood.

credits.title: Bachelor's Handbag
credits.overview: During a laid-back Aussie barbecue, Damien returns to find the roast chicken missing. As suspicion spreads among his mates, accusations fly and chaos erupts in this comedic suburban whodunit.
